default.text: What does a HubSpot CRM implementation include?
default.detail: A typical implementation includes process and requirements workshops, CRM architecture, HubSpot configuration, data migration, automation, integrations, reporting, testing, user training and go-live support. The exact scope depends on your business processes and HubSpot subscription.

default.text: How long does a HubSpot implementation take?
default.detail: Most of our CRM implementations take 3–6 months. A focused implementation for one team can be faster, while multi-Hub implementations involving complex migrations or integrations may take longer.

default.text: What is the difference between HubSpot onboarding and CRM implementation?
default.detail: HubSpot onboarding helps you get started with the platform. A CRM implementation goes deeper: we design how HubSpot should support your business processes and then configure the CRM, data structure, automation, reporting and integrations around those requirements.

default.text: Do we need to have our processes defined before we start?
default.detail: No. Process design is part of our implementation approach. We work with your teams to understand the current process, identify gaps and agree on how it should work before configuring it in HubSpot.

default.text: Can you migrate our existing CRM to HubSpot?
default.detail: Yes. We can migrate data from existing CRM and marketing platforms, spreadsheets and other systems. Migration typically includes data assessment, mapping, cleaning, migration and validation.

default.text: Can HubSpot integrate with our ERP or other business systems?
default.detail: Usually, yes. We work with native HubSpot integrations as well as custom API integrations for ERP systems, websites, telephony, configurators and other business applications.

default.text: Can you implement several HubSpot Hubs at the same time?
default.detail: Yes. We implement Marketing, Sales, Service, Content and Data Hub individually or as part of a connected multi-Hub implementation.
We can continue working with your team through ongoing HubSpot support and continuous optimization — improving automation, reporting, data quality and processes as your business evolves.
